message.content: During the picnic planning session, RexxarRemar suggested bringing blankets or chairs for seating, as it might get a bit crowded. Additionally, he proposed having a mix of snacks and drinks to keep everyone energized. Specifically, RexxarRemar recommended having a mix of food options including desserts to ensure there was something for everyone to enjoy. He also suggested having a small competition for the best dessert brought by participants, which could be a fun activity. To keep everyone hydrated, RexxarRemar proposed setting up a small drink station with water and refreshing beverages. Overall, RexxarRemar's suggestions were geared towards ensuring the picnic was both enjoyable and comfortable for all attendees.
